outcome: Histopathological changes in placenta (intervillous space, villous branching, syncytial knots)
ET-1 contraction response of umbilical arteries
cohort: The study included 20 pregnant women (10 with preeclampsia and 10 normotensive controls), aged 20-39 years, who delivered by cesarean section at term.
finding: The preeclampsia group showed significantly higher placental ET-1 mRNA expression and immunoreactivity, decreased placental miR-1 and miR-125b levels, increased miR-125b levels in maternal and umbilical cord blood, and specific histopathological changes, though ET-1 contraction responses did not differ between groups.
